_comentario: Regla 31: Expresiones con some / any / no. Tanda 1/1 (60 ejercicios, en tríos: pregunta con any, afirmación con some, negación con no/not any).

traducciones.englishWord: Do you have any questions?
I have some questions.
I don't have any questions.
Is anyone in the office?
There is someone in the office.

traducciones.spanishWord: No hay nadie en la oficina.
traducciones.englishWord: There isn't anyone in the office.
Do you need anything from the store?
I need something from the store.

traducciones.spanishWord: No necesito nada de la tienda.
traducciones.englishWord: I don't need anything from the store.
Did you buy anything interesting?
I bought something interesting.
I didn't buy anything interesting.
Is there any problem?
There is some problem.
There isn't any problem.
Did anyone help you?
Someone helped me.
No one helped me.
Do you have any plans for today?
I have some plans for today.

traducciones.spanishWord: No tengo ningún plan para hoy.
traducciones.englishWord: I don't have any plans for today.
Did you see anyone at the party?

traducciones.spanishWord: Vi a alguien en la fiesta.
traducciones.englishWord: I saw someone at the party.

traducciones.spanishWord: No vi a nadie en la fiesta.
traducciones.englishWord: I didn't see anyone at the party.
Do you want anything to eat?
I want something to eat.
I don't want anything to eat.
Is there any store nearby?
There is some store nearby.
There isn't any store nearby.
Do you know anything about this?
I know something about this.
I don't know anything about this.
Did anyone call this morning?
Someone called this morning.
No one called this morning.
Do you need help with anything?
I need help with something.
I don't need help with anything.

traducciones.spanishWord: ¿Hay algo de comida en la nevera?
traducciones.englishWord: Is there any food in the fridge?

traducciones.spanishWord: Hay algo de comida en la nevera.
traducciones.englishWord: There is some food in the fridge.

traducciones.spanishWord: No hay nada de comida en la nevera.
traducciones.englishWord: There isn't any food in the fridge.
Do you have any friends in that city?

traducciones.spanishWord: Tengo algunos amigos en esa ciudad.
traducciones.englishWord: I have some friends in that city.

traducciones.spanishWord: No tengo ningún amigo en esa ciudad.
traducciones.englishWord: I don't have any friends in that city.
Did you hear anything strange last night?
I heard something strange last night.
I didn't hear anything strange last night.
Did anyone leave this here?
Someone left this here.
No one left this here.
Do you have anything to say?
I have something to say.
I don't have anything to say.
Is there any way to help you?
There is some way to help you.

traducciones.spanishWord: No hay ninguna forma de ayudarte.
traducciones.englishWord: There isn't any way to help you.
Did anyone see my keys?
Someone saw my keys.
No one saw my keys.
